description: This PHP source file defines the SaveCustomerController class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. The class extends an abstract controller and manages rendering logic for customer-related views based on request attributes, specifically determining whether to edit or save a customer based on the presence of an 'id' attribute.

classes.name: SaveCustomerController
classes.description: Handles the rendering of customer save/edit views in the OrangeHRM Time plugin by dynamically selecting the component and passing the customer ID if available.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view component before rendering based on whether a customer ID is present in the request attributes.
